purpose: Exploratory MOS and bidirectional-switch observations; not approved test oracles or implemented kirimasim support. Separate from the 79-item feature inventory.
source_origin: Original programs written for this investigation. No other simulator source or tests were read.
kirimasim_execution: Not measured in this exploratory dataset; MOS/bidirectional source integration remains unsupported.
interpretation: Reference agreement is observational evidence, not proof of IEEE conformance. Positive intervals, wired-net channels, force transit and delayed startup require specification review.

probes.name: root_removed_ring
probes.source:
`timescale 1ns/1ns
module top;bit drive=1;wire a,b,c;assign a=drive?1'b1:1'bz;tran t0(a,b),t1(b,c),t2(c,a);initial begin #1;$display("on %b%b%b",a,b,c);drive=0;#1;$display("off %b%b%b",a,b,c);end endmodule

probes.name: floating_self
probes.source:
`timescale 1ns/1ns
module top;wire a;tran t(a,a);initial begin #1;$display("%b %v",a,a);end endmodule

probes.name: strength_only
probes.source:
`timescale 1ns/1ns
module top;bit boost=0;int changes;wire a,y;assign(weak1,weak0)a=1'b1;assign(strong1,strong0)a=boost?1'b1:1'bz;nmos m(y,a,1'b1);assign(pull1,pull0)y=1'b0;always @(a)changes++;initial begin #2;changes=0;$display("before %b %b %v",a,y,a);boost=1;#1;$display("after %b %b %v %0d",a,y,a,changes);end endmodule
